title: Cool but might be better
body: I have been using the app for almost 5 months. I really like your visual design, but switching between habits and having a lot of them is painful. Please work on navigation
author: dimaready

title: Best. Hi
body:

I’ve been using for 6 month, love it. But I found that, in the section by months, we don’t have the count of habits.

in January, I made 10 times, I would love to see the counts (maybe on the bottom)
